# Vulnetix GitHub Actions

One composite action per CLI command, used as `Vulnetix/cli/<name>@v3`. The root action
(`Vulnetix/cli@v3`, with `task:`) still works and runs the same scripts.

| Action | Runs |
|---|---|
| [`setup`](setup.md) | Install the Vulnetix CLI and put it on PATH for later steps. |
| [`sca`](sca.md) | Scan dependencies for known vulnerabilities (vulnetix sca). |
| [`sast`](sast.md) | Scan source code with the SAST rules (vulnetix sast). |
| [`secrets`](secrets.md) | Scan for committed secrets (vulnetix secrets). |
| [`iac`](iac.md) | Scan infrastructure as code (vulnetix iac). |
| [`containers`](containers.md) | Scan container files and images (vulnetix containers). |
| [`license`](license.md) | Evaluate dependency licences against the licence policy (vulnetix license). |
| [`malscan`](malscan.md) | Scan installed dependencies for malicious code (vulnetix malscan). |
| [`analyze`](analyze.md) | Report the repository's tech stack, ownership and risk (vulnetix analyze). |
| [`cbom`](cbom.md) | Write a cryptography bill of materials (vulnetix cbom). |
| [`aibom`](aibom.md) | Write an AI bill of materials (vulnetix aibom). |
| [`sbom`](sbom.md) | Write a CycloneDX SBOM (vulnetix cdx). |
| [`upload`](upload.md) | Upload one artifact file to Vulnetix (vulnetix upload). |
| [`gha-upload`](gha-upload.md) | Upload every artifact of this workflow run to Vulnetix (vulnetix gha upload). |
| [`tea-release`](tea-release.md) | Publish a product release and its artifacts to the Transparency Exchange API (vulnetix tea release). |
| [`config-plan`](config-plan.md) | Plan Platform IaC documents against the config engine and comment the plan on the pull request (vulnetix config plan). |
| [`config-apply`](config-apply.md) | Apply Platform IaC documents through the config engine (vulnetix config apply). |
| [`attest`](attest.md) | Verify an artefact's signature, identity and provenance (vulnetix attest verify). |
| [`jail`](jail.md) | Assess the repository against the organisation's jail policy (vulnetix jail). |
| [`vex`](vex.md) | Work with VEX documents: validate, list, merge or apply (vulnetix vex <vex-command>). |
| [`github-publish`](github-publish.md) | Publish existing results into GitHub: code scanning, the dependency graph, release assets and security campaigns (vulnetix gha publish). |

Every action installs the CLI (`setup` alone does only that), passes credentials only as
environment variables, runs the command with `--artifact-manifest`, and then, as asked:
publishes to GitHub, uploads the written files as an artifact, attests them, and attaches them
to a release. The last step fails the job when the command failed and `fail-on-findings` is
true, so the artifact, attestation and publish steps run either way.

## Permissions

| Feature | Permissions needed |
|---|---|
| Code scanning | `security-events: write` (plus `actions: read` on private repositories) |
| Dependency graph | `contents: write` |
| Attestations | `id-token: write` and `attestations: write` |
| Release assets | `contents: write` |
| config-plan pull request comment | `pull-requests: write` |
| Repository advisories | A PAT or GitHub App token with repository advisories write |
| Security campaigns | A PAT or GitHub App token of an organization owner or security manager, with GitHub Advanced Security, plus a Vulnetix `vmt_` token with the campaigns read scope |
